# Choose Your Own Destination with LYGG


Jaa artikkeli:


25.11.2026


News


**No direct flight where your company needs to go? Let’s create one! With our new Tailored Route tool, companies can now explore their own short European air connections, get a price estimate and request a flight.**


Whether travelling for project work, crew changes, site visits or business meetings, LYGG offers tailored flights for both one-off and recurring travel needs.


Our new tool makes planning short European group flights easy. Simply choose your departure and destination, select your travel dates and number of passengers, get a price estimate and submit your flight request.


## December Offer – Flights from €369 per Person


Short European flights starting from €369 per person for groups of eight or more, travelling by the end of January 2027.


**Your destination. Your schedule. Your flight.**


[Explore your route →](https://lygg.com/tailored-route/)
